comparison.objective: Drain water from a pan through a lid held ajar while retaining dumplings, then return the pan to the stove.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual lid-gap regulation and coordinated pan tipping with particulate retention.
comparison.success_condition: Pan ends upright on the stove, sufficient water beads reach the sink, and all dumplings remain in the pan.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is coordinated pouring and retention. It shares force coordination only at a generic level with the candidate.
